description: Main application source code for a Bluetooth Mesh demo using Zephyr RTOS, including mesh configuration, provisioning, heartbeat handling, and button interaction.

methods.name: heartbeat
methods.description: Handles incoming heartbeat messages, updates board display and plays sound.

methods.name: attention_on
methods.description: Activates attention indicator and plays a pattern.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth mesh, loads settings, provisions device, and configures mesh parameters.

methods.name: board_button_1_pressed
methods.description: Sends a vendor-specific button press message over the mesh network.

methods.name: board_set_target
methods.description: Cycles the target address for button messages.

methods.name: board_play
methods.description: Sets a sound pattern to be played.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes system and starts Bluetooth.
